title: Personal Checking: owner questions a monthly maintenance fee posted today
content:
## Situation and business effect

This entry applies when the owner of a Personal Checking account questions a monthly maintenance fee dated the current business day, which is the account's statement cycle closing date. It governs whether that fee was assessed although a waiver of the tier was met, and so whether the fee is refunded to the owner as a bank-error correction. When a refund is owed, the agent posts it; the owner sees it in the account activity immediately and the posted ledger balance rises by the refunded amount. When none is owed, nothing is posted under this entry.

## Posting the refund

A refund owed under this entry is posted with **refund_same_day_maintenance_fee_e9518b99**, an internal tool that the agent must first unlock (unlock_agent_discoverable_tool) and then call (call_agent_discoverable_tool).

**What the tool does.** One call writes one refund entry on the account, dated today, that refunds the named monthly maintenance fee entry, records the refund as a bank-error correction for the monthly maintenance fee, and raises the account's posted ledger balance by the refunded amount at once. It records exactly the amount given against the named fee and does not check the fee, its date, its amount or any earlier refund.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Class | Business meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|---|
| checking_account_id | Id | The checking account on which the maintenance fee was charged, from the checking account lookup | Reference number |
| customer_id | Id | The owner's customer reference number, from the customer profile lookup | Reference number |
| source_item_id | Id | The monthly maintenance fee entry being refunded, from the checking activity lookup | Reference number |
| amount | Fixed format | Refund amount in U.S. dollars, a positive figure | Plain number with two decimals, half-up rounding, e.g. 12.34 |
| statement_cycle | Fixed format | The cycle today's posting belongs to | YYYY-MM, being the month that cycle closes in |

## Return

The tool answers with a confirmation sentence naming the new refund entry reference number, the fee entry it refunds, the amount refunded in USD with 2 decimal places, and the account's new posted ledger balance in USD with 2 decimal places. Receiving it means the refund is posted.

## Calling contract Q&A

**Q: If the fee turns out not to qualify, will the tool refuse the call?**
A: No. The tool does not check the fee, its date, its amount or any earlier refund; the refund decision is made before calling it.

**Q: Which entry is named in source_item_id?**
A: The monthly maintenance fee entry being refunded.

**Hypothetical call (illustrative references only):** checking_account_id "CHK-EXAMPLE", customer_id "CUST-EXAMPLE", source_item_id "MMF-EXAMPLE", amount 13.50, statement_cycle "2026-09". The receipt names the new refund entry, fee MMF-EXAMPLE, 13.50 USD refunded and the new ledger balance.
